judgments.rationale: The element is the title link of the 'Saiba mais...' group in the footer site map (href /saiba-mais, no title). claimTrue: the snapshot shows its own list item holding a nested list with the links 'Portal do Estado do RS', 'Agência de Notícias', 'Agenda do Governador' and 'Secretarias e Órgãos do Estado', so something around it does speak to where it goes. The heading just before it (h2 'Descomplica RS') does not help, but the list item is programmatically determined context under this rubric. I opened /saiba-mais live: it is a page titled 'Saiba mais...' whose only content is a list of exactly those four child pages. So the link text with its list item tells users it opens the index page of that group, and sighted users get no more than that from the column layout. elementFails: no for 2.4.4 (the generic wording is a 2.4.9 matter, Level AAA). The model had the list item text and still judged wrongly.

In the capture the teal #156b66 text sits below the red bar, over the yellow hero image (visible in the screenshot).
